properties.notes: Planning permission 15/16883/FUL for 41 net additional homes (C3) granted on 10/02/2017.. Demolition of former health centre; change of use and extension to No.3 Oakhill and erection of 2 x four-storey residential blocks including accommodation in roof space (41 x residential flats (C3) in total comprising 16 x one-bedroom, 17 x two-bedroom and 8 x three-bedroom units).
